note: Both sets cover the same core drivetrain properties with accurate values, units, and supporting quotes, and both contain a few duplicate claims (brake torque, damping constant, gearbox ratio). Set B additionally captures the DOWEC turbine power-loss figure (0.35 MW at ~6.25 MW aerodynamic power) with its conditions preserved and correctly attributed to the DOWEC machine, a fact Set A omits. Set A binds a few values more precisely to the component (gearbox, driveshaft, generator), but Set B's turbine-level bindings still name the component in the property, so they are not misreadings. Neither set invents values, so B's extra faithful claim gives it the edge.
